risks.risk: The machine may not power on or reach operating temperature.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on with the digital display active and the heating/cooling system running.

risks.risk: The hydraulic or pneumatic system may be leaking or failing.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine under pressure or a close-up of the seals.

risks.risk: The plastic injection mechanism may be seized or unable to cycle.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine completing a full injection cycle.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like molds, nozzles, or tooling may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included molds and tooling.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and operating.
Photo of the included molds and tooling.
Video showing the machine completing an injection cycle.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
